jobs.title: AVP, Business Consultant
jobs.description:
Where Ambition Meets Innovation

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

Job Overview:

*This role will require frequent travel to Bedminster, NJ.*

The AVP, Business Consultant, LPL Independent Advisor Network role is part of LPL’s Field Management team. Field Management provides end-to-end leadership support to advisors and staff through managing personnel, practices, and properties to drive outsized growth and satisfaction. As part of the Field Management team, you will have the opportunity to directly live out LPL’s mission: We take care of our advisors, so they can take care of their clients.

As AVP, Business Consultant, LPL Independent Advisor Network, your primary focus will be helping to support the Regional Branch Director in leading, managing, and coaching the financial advisors/teams within your region. You will play a key leadership role, supporting financial advisors/teams through all phases of their lifecycle (i.e., growth through succession). The successful leader will have a comprehensive understanding of the LPL Independent Advisor Network model and its discrete solutions (i.e Consultants, Service, etc).

Additionally, you will help further the development of LPL Independent Advisor Network by providing key leadership insights and supporting the implementation of frameworks that increase ease of doing business and promote advisor growth and satisfaction. Not only will you be a key advocate for our advisors across the organization, but also an ambassador of the LPL Independent Advisor Network in your region.

Responsibilities:
- Build and sustain deep advisor relationships while maintaining high advisor retention and satisfaction.
- Support the growth aspirations of advisors/teams through coaching; execute on sales strategy to drive growth within your region.
- Strategize and execute on teaming and succession planning opportunities, including, but not limited to, identifying successors, merging teams with similar practices, etc.
- Partner with the sales organization to drive the recruitment of advisors by educating them on the mission and vision of LPL Independent Advisor Network and associated benefits to their practice in joining your region.
- Collaborate with the LPL Independent Advisor Network Consultants and internal partners to increase awareness/adoption of appropriate tools and resources (e.g., financial planning, advisory, high net worth services)
- Help drive outsized growth in Same Store Sales, Net New Assets, and client satisfaction scores (NPS).
- Support the acclimation of new advisors/teams to the LPL Independent Advisor Network.

What are we looking for?
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness , act with integrity , and are driven to help our clients succeed . We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of financial services experience
- FINRA Series 7,66 (or ability to obtain within 120 days)
- 3+ years of experience working as a branch manager, associate complex manager or another field-based sales role
- Ability to travel visiting branch offices and participating in recruit meetings

Core Competencies:
- Track record for successfully bringing on and integrating recruits/new teams
- Strong business acumen with a deep understanding of how advisors grow and how to support their growth
- Ability to motivate advisors/teams to drive positive business outcomes
- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to balance the need to build trust/respect amongst your advisors with the need to maintain the integrity of LPL Advisor Networks.
- Exceptional problem-solving skills; capable of assessing complex problems, prioritizing key issues and focusing on relevant facts while maintaining a strong execution focus
- Excellent communication skills, both written and oral
- Executive presence with a demonstrated ability to lead change and influence at all levels

Preferences:
- Bachelor’s Degree
- Minimum of 10 years of experience in the financial services and/or wealth management industry
- Series 9/10 or 24

#LPL-PA

Pay Range:
$114,330.00 - $190,550.00

Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer!

Company Overview:
LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor-mediated marketplace(6) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. The firm provides a wide range of advisor affiliation models, investment solutions, fintech tools and practice management services, ensuring that advisors and institutions have the flexibility to choose the business model, services, and technology resources they need to run thriving businesses. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com.

At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients.

For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com .

Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. EOE.

jobs.title: VPII, Corporate Strategy Lead
jobs.description:
Lead with Purpose, Unlock Your Team’s Passion

At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience — shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win – clients, LPL, and most importantly our, employees.

If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what’s possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today.

LPL Financial is seeking a high-performing VPII, Corporate Strategy Lead to join the Corporate Strategy team. This role will report to the SVP, Head of Corporate Strategy & Pricing and will help shape the firm’s long-term strategic agenda, translate complex market and business dynamics into executive-ready recommendations, and lead high-priority initiatives that materially impact LPL’s growth, competitive positioning, operating model, and enterprise value.

The ideal candidate will bring the structured problem-solving, analytical rigor, executive communication, and project leadership skills typically developed at a top-tier management consulting firm, with experience comparable to a Senior Manager, Engagement Manager, Principal, Associate Partner, or early Junior Partner level. This individual should be senior enough to independently lead complex strategy workstreams and influence executives, while still operating as a hands-on strategy leader who can personally structure problems, develop analyses, build narratives, and coach junior team members.

Responsibilities:
- Lead enterprise strategy initiatives: Own and drive strategic projects that address LPL’s most important opportunities and risks, including corporate growth, competitive positioning, advisor and end-client value propositions, operating model evolution, AI-enabled transformation, pricing strategy, M&A strategy, and adjacent market expansion.
- Shape executive decision-making: Frame ambiguous strategic questions, develop fact-based recommendations, and translate complex analysis into clear, practical options for senior executives, Management Committee members, and Board-level discussions.
- Build strategic narratives: Create compelling storylines and executive-ready materials that simplify complexity, clarify tradeoffs, and help leaders align on strategy, investment priorities, and execution paths.
- Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner with business lines, Finance, Technology, Product, Legal, Risk, Transformation, Corporate Development, and other senior stakeholders to ensure strategic recommendations are grounded in business realities and connected to execution.
- Advance competitive and market intelligence: Monitor the evolving wealth management landscape, advisor and end-client needs, new entrants, AI-driven disruption, monetization models, and competitor moves to identify implications for LPL’s strategy.
- Develop strategic options and business cases: Lead market sizing, financial modeling, scenario analysis, strategic option development, and risk assessment to support major enterprise decisions.
- Support Board and executive strategy sessions: Contribute to the development of Board, Management Committee, and senior leadership materials, including annual strategy sessions, strategic updates, and decision-oriented pre-reads.
- Manage and develop strategy talent: Lead project teams, coach analysts and managers, raise the quality of problem-solving and communication, and help build Corporate Strategy as a talent feeder for broader leadership roles across LPL.
- Translate strategy into execution: Work with partners across the firm to convert strategic recommendations into roadmaps, governance models, operating rhythms, success metrics, and implementation plans.

What are we looking for?
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness , act with integrity , and are driven to help our clients succeed . We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, finance, strategy, engineering, liberal arts, or a related field.
- 10+ years of professional experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, business strategy, corporate development, strategic finance, or a comparable strategy-oriented role.
- Significant experience at a top-tier management consulting firm or equivalent environment, with experience comparable to Senior Manager, Engagement Manager, Principal, Associate Partner, or early Junior Partner level.
- Demonstrated ability to lead complex strategy projects from problem definition through recommendation and executive alignment.
- Strong financial and analytical capabilities, including business case development, market sizing, scenario analysis, and executive-level synthesis.

Core Competencies:
- Strategic problem solving: Structures ambiguous questions, develops hypotheses, and identifies the highest-value path to insight.
- Executive communication: Converts complex analysis into concise, compelling messages for senior audiences.
- Business judgment: Balances growth, economics, client impact, risk, and execution feasibility.
- Analytical rigor: Uses data, market intelligence, and financial analysis to support recommendations.
- Stakeholder influence: Builds alignment across leaders with different objectives, incentives, and operating realities.
- Team leadership: Sets direction, manages workstreams, develops talent, and raises the quality of team output.
- Execution orientation: Connects strategy to roadmaps, owners, metrics, and operating mechanisms.
- Enterprise mindset: Prioritizes what is best for LPL overall, not just an individual function or business line.

Preferences:
- MBA or advanced degree from a top-tier program.
- Experience in wealth management, brokerage, asset management, banking, fintech, insurance, or another financial services sector.
- Experience working on pricing strategy, M&A strategy, platform strategy, AI or digital transformation, operating model redesign, or advisor/client experience strategy.
- Experience preparing materials for C-suite, Management Committee, Board of Directors, or investor-facing discussions.
- Demonstrated ability to develop strategies that connect external market shifts to internal business model implications.
- Experience operating in both consulting and corporate environments.

$178,293.00 - $297,155.00

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

Job Overview:
The Principal M&A Architect is responsible for leading, analyzing, and designing the Enterprise Data Architecture (EDA) for the Merger and acquisition (M&A) group, which supports our extraordinary company growth projections and digital experiences vision.

Responsibilities:
Strategic M&A Architecture Leader with extensive experience leading technology due diligence, integration strategy, target-state architecture, and business transformation initiatives associated with mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and strategic partnerships. Proven ability to align business objectives, technology platforms, data assets, and operating models to accelerate value realization and reduce integration risk.
Core Contributions:
- M&A Strategy & Technology Due Diligence – Led end-to-end technology assessments for mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures, evaluating application portfolios, infrastructure, data platforms, cybersecurity posture, technical debt, and integration complexity to inform investment decisions and transaction structuring.

- Integration Architecture & Value Realization – Defined target-state architecture, integration roadmaps, and transition strategies to enable seamless consolidation of business capabilities, applications, data, and technology platforms while accelerating synergy realization.

- Enterprise Architecture Leadership – Directed cross-functional architecture teams across business, application, data, cloud, security, and infrastructure domains to ensure alignment with enterprise standards, modernization objectives, and future-state operating models.

- Application & Platform Rationalization – Led application portfolio assessments, capability mapping, and platform consolidation efforts to eliminate redundancies, reduce operational costs, and improve technology efficiency following acquisitions.

- Data & Business Process Integration – Designed strategies for customer, financial, operational, and regulatory data integration while harmonizing business processes across acquired organizations to support scalable enterprise operations.

- Risk, Governance & Compliance – Evaluated technology, operational, cybersecurity, and regulatory risks during transaction lifecycles and established governance frameworks to ensure compliance, resiliency, and business continuity.

- Stakeholder & Executive Engagement – Partnered with C-suite executives, business leaders, product organizations, and technology teams to align integration priorities, investment decisions, and transformation roadmaps with enterprise strategic objectives.

- Cloud & Modernization Strategy – Drove post-acquisition modernization initiatives, including cloud migration, platform standardization, API enablement, data transformation, and adoption of strategic enterprise capabilities.

- Operating Model Transformation – Defined future-state organizational, process, and technology operating models to enable scalable growth, improve customer experience, and support long-term business objectives.

- Program Leadership – Managed large-scale integration programs and multi-year transformation roadmaps, ensuring successful delivery of critical milestones, effective risk management, and measurable business outcomes.

We want strong collaborators who can deliver a world-class client experience. We are looking for people who thrive in a fast-paced environment, are client-focused and team-oriented, and can execute in a way that encourages creativity and continuous improvement.

- 5+ years experience migrating legacy platforms to modern data platform

Core Competencies:
- Proficiency in defining current and future state Data Architecture models.
